The three sibling per-repo runbooks were found AFTER this issue was filed and have now been amended DIRECTLY (same four spots as the main runbook — Non-negotiables, §2 checklist, §9 merge criteria, §9 hard stops):

- `repo-queue-worker-instruction-opencode.md` (the one the opencode lanes that escalated #1757 actually read)
- `repo-queue-worker-instruction-openchamber.md`
- `repo-queue-worker-instruction-nix.md`

Verified: zero `Drew-owned` occurrences remain across all FOUR runbooks; each carries the label-based definition (held = labeled `held` / `user/owned` / `do-not-merge` / `do-not-auto-edit` only; dezren39 authorship never marks a PR held).

Remaining for this sweep (unchanged from the issue body): the 3 hatch-personal cron definitions, the program_tending.py "Drew's own feature PRs" line, and the archival design docs.

Explicitly OUT of scope (non-operative historical prose, no action): `audit-mainchat.md` (audit log line), `shadow-packets/*` (frozen generated task packets), `design-mill/threads/thread-design.md` (historical design prose).

**Verdict: REAL AND CURRENT — all four remaining sweep targets confirmed verbatim at fresh reads (2026-11-08 ~23:35Z).**

1. `crons/hourly/issue-sweep-devtoday-code__interval@2h.md` line 48 — "Drew's own in-progress feature PRs (and anything the backlog marks held or Drew-owned, e.g. the #430/#431/#438 stack and held PR #478) are NOT yours to commandeer…" — CONFIRMED. (Path drift since filing: the repo copy now lives under the goal workspace `keep-the-four-repos-healthy/crons/hourly/`, not `hatch-personal/workspace/cron.d`.)
2. `crons/daily/opencode-daily-top-issue__daily@07:12:00.md` line 33 — "no BLOCKED / held / Drew-owned / needs-Drew marker" — CONFIRMED (goal-workspace copy; live job body verified identical).
3. `crons/daily/opencode-daily-top-issue-code__daily@07:32:00.md` line 32 — same shape — CONFIRMED (goal-workspace copy; live job body verified identical).
4. `scripts/program_tending.py` line 13 on code main `8f79a40162b5` — "Drew's own feature PRs get a check-in comment at 7 days, never a packet" — CONFIRMED. The same file's `HARD_STOPS` tuple (line 38) is already label-based, so the fix here is to key the 7-day check-in rule on the `user/owned` label instead of authorship.

**Ordering / blocker facts for the fix:**
- All three cron jobs (`issue-sweep-devtoday-code`, `opencode-daily-top-issue`, `opencode-daily-top-issue-code`) are currently **disabled** — the old phrasing is dormant, not actively steering runs today. The sweep is still worth doing before any re-enable.

- In the code repo, a `grep -rn 'Drew-owned'` outside `doc/` returns nothing else — no other operative copies found. The archival design docs named in the issue body stay untouched, per the issue.

**Routing:** follow-up fix packet enqueued as a `small_fix` task (dedupe `repo-health:v1:fix:developing-today/code:issue:7077`) covering items 1–4. This triage task completes as `triaged`.
